Maya (CS): quick heads up 1 min from Aurelia onboarding call: a couple of friction points and one ask that could affect renewal. can we triage?
Evan (PM): thanks, paste what you have
Maya (CS): 1) onboarding SDK examples assume static tokens, but customer uses short-lived rotated tokens -> confusion
Maya (CS): 2) billing view lacks per-route cost breakdown, finance asked for per-project visibility
Maya (CS): 3) observed failures when sending 20k token contexts, default timeout/limits hit
Maya (CS): feature ask: Dedicated customer-level model pinning (they want guaranteed model isolation)
Ravi (Eng): timeout looks like a runtime param; we can add per-deployment override. small schema change + spike. estimate 3 dev days after spike.
Lina (Solutions): model pinning overlaps with Dedicated roadmap and security (KMS). I can draft a vendor/SOW note and talk to sales.
Evan (PM): priority suggestion: token docs = P1 quick-doc, runtime timeout = P1 infra, billing per-route = P2 product, model pinning = P0 enterprise. agree?
Maya (CS): agree. renewal risk: flag as medium until model pinning + billing clarity are addressed. will notify AE.
triage-bot: created ticket CS-8291 in product-triage with labels [aurelia,onboarding,renewal-risk]
Maya (CS): owners: Maya -> attach call clips, Ravi -> runtime spike, Evan -> update roadmap and inform AE, Lina -> enterprise scoping.
Ravi (Eng): starting spike now. will put notes in /docs/internal/runtime-timeout-spikes.md and propose config like:
Ravi (Eng): runtime:
  default_inference_timeout_ms: 90000
  allow_per_deployment_override: true
Evan (PM): can we get docs + spike notes by next Tue (1777780800)? then we can scope a small PO for timeout.
Ravi (Eng): yes, spike + PR planned by then.
Lina (Solutions): will drop a draft SOW and KMS checklist into CS-8291 by EOW.
Maya (CS): thanks all. will follow up in Fri standup. :thumbsup:
